profile.sic_description: Mining & Quarrying of  Nonmetallic Minerals (No Fuels)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: paid facts for periods ending 2011-12-31..2026-06-30; declared facts for the periods the paid tag does not cover (2011-09-30..2011-09-30, 1 facts); the paid tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30, the declared tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the declared tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the paid tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
notes: quarterly DPS (declared): 2 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2011-09-30: 0.02 (filed 2011-11-08) used, not 0 (filed 2012-11-06) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2020-06-30: 0.0025 (filed 2020-08-06) used, not 0.25 (filed 2021-08-05) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2020-01-01..2020-06-30 − 2020-01-01..2020-03-31)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

quarterly DPS (paid): 2 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2020-06-30: 0.0025 (filed 2020-08-06) used, not 0.25 (filed 2021-08-05) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2020-01-01..2020-06-30 − 2020-01-01..2020-03-31); 2022-09-30: 0.000625 (filed 2022-11-09) used, not 0.00625 (filed 2023-11-07) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

dps_basis: paid facts for periods ending 2011-12-31..2026-06-30; declared facts for the periods the paid tag does not cover (2011-09-30..2011-09-30, 1 facts) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 0.04 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.00375, 2026-06-30: 0.00375) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.00375, 2025-06-30: 0.00375)
